Package it.unipr.sportclubmanager.model

Class Member

java.lang.Object
it.unipr.sportclubmanager.model.Person
it.unipr.sportclubmanager.model.Member
Direct Known Subclasses:
Administrator
public class Member extends Person
The Member class represents a member of the sports club. A member can enroll in activities (competition and courses) and cancel their enrollment.
